messages:
olivia_pm: Kickoff: proposing "spill-queue" adaptive degrade for reserved pools as a safer alternative to force-eviction during capacity pressure. aim: keep tenant-level SLOs while allowing short surges.
andrew_eng: sounds promising. how does spill-queue differ from current preempt behavior?
mala_sre: current is hard-evict or backpressure. spill-queue is a bounded per-tenant queue that temporarily routes excess requests to a shared overflow lane with throttled throughput and best-effort latency. we then prioritize sticky KV-cache warmers to reduce regressions.
jon_data: telemetry reqs: per-tenant queue_length, avg_wait_ms, drop_rate, and ratio of overflow_to_success. need synthetic probe that simulates 50-500 req/sec bursts.
andrew_eng: rough config sketch: 
```
reserved_pool:
  mode: reserved
  overcommit_pct: 10
  spill_queue:
    enabled: true
    queue_size: 300
    max_delay_ms: 1200
  preempt_policy: degrade-notify
  autoscale:
    backoff_ms: 30000
    scale_step: 10_percent
```
olivia_pm: UX note: customers should see a clear "overflow" metric and an explanation: "requests routed to spill-queue may have degraded latency; consider raising reserved capacity". Also discuss billing: do we bill overflow consumption at standard rate or a premium?
nate_sales: From sales POV, prefer standard rate for small overflows, premium for sustained overflow > 10% of committed tokens. Also want an SLA line item for large customers.
legal-bot: Flagged: billing proration language needs review. I'll loop in Contracts for enterprise wording.
mala_sre: launch criteria proposal: 1) end-to-end canary with 3 pilot customers across two regions, 2) chaos test: preempt and node loss with <=2% error increase, 3) telemetry and alerts in product console, 4) rollback path to hard-evict.
jon_data: add success metric: overflow_recovery_time median < 3s and P99 latency within +10% of baseline during pilot.
andrew_eng: implementation plan: admission controller per-pool with spill-queue hooks, small injector in serving runtime, and a config flag to toggle spill-queue per tenant. estimate 3 sprints for core + 1 sprint for GA hardening.
olivia_pm: decision discussion: do we default this ON for new reserved pools and OFF for existing?
nate_sales: suggest default ON for new pools (gives better UX) but OFF for existing without explicit consent — customers expect stable behavior.
olivia_pm: compromise: default ON for new customers; existing customers default OFF; provide a one-click opt-in in Console with billing consent modal.
legal-bot: Contracts review required for GA for customers > $50k ARR.
deploy-bot: Reminder: run preflight pipeline `spill-queue/e2e` before canary.
mala_sre: owners: Andrew (eng lead), Mala (SRE), Jon (telemetry), Olivia (PM). Pilot targets: three customers (two mid-market, one enterprise) by end of Q.
olivia_pm: I'll draft a short pilot brief and risk register (billing, cache regression, cross-tenant fairness). pushing to roadmap sheet.
andrew_eng: will open RFC + proto PR. planning meeting scheduled Friday 09:30.
olivia_pm: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread; we'll finalize pilot customer list in the planning meeting.
